business_problem: Autostrade needed to move motorway IT operations and service management to the cloud while keeping thousands of road-safety systems observable, reducing legacy infrastructure costs, and improving incident and change control across a complex transport environment.
solution_summary: Autostrade consolidated service operations onto the ServiceNow AI Platform and shut down a dozen legacy servers as it moved away from an older on-premises monitoring stack. Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Service Operations Workspace now give the motorway operator visibility into applications, databases, servers, and infrastructure that monitor toll payment, road conditions, tunnels, and traffic flow. The CMDB stores configuration items and service relationships so event impacts can be visualized across about 1,000 service maps, while integrations with AWS and on-premises management tools help populate that model automatically. On top of the monitoring layer, IT Operations Management and IT Service Management support incident handling, change management, release management, and knowledge-driven operator guidance. The result is a cloud-ready, unified operations model that improves control over a safety-critical transport estate while making automation and future observability plans easier to execute.

solution_components.name: Discovery
solution_components.role: Automates identification of assets and populates the configuration model across cloud and on-premises environments.

solution_components.name: Service Mapping
solution_components.role: Builds service maps that show how configuration items and applications relate and where incidents have impact.

solution_components.name: Event Management
solution_components.role: Monitors the environment and raises alarms that operators can correlate with service context.

solution_components.name: Service Operations Workspace
solution_components.role: Gives agents and operators a unified place to manage events, incidents, and service context.

solution_components.name: IT Operations Management
solution_components.role: Supports asset monitoring, service mapping, and event-driven operational control.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Runs incident, change, and release processes on the same unified platform as IT operations.

data_flow: Discovery and integrations load asset and service data into the CMDB, where Service Mapping relates those items into about 1,000 impact maps. Event Management then raises alarms against that model, and operators use Service Operations Workspace plus ITSM workflows to correlate incidents, manage change and release actions, and follow knowledge-guided responses.
business_outcome: Autostrade lowered costs by moving off its legacy on-premises system, shut down a dozen legacy servers, created about 1,000 service maps for impact visibility, improved incident-resolution speed, and strengthened control over the motorway applications and infrastructure that support more than four million travelers daily.
